_comment: The analyst's SOURCE TARGETS — the systems they chose to work with, of the ones their login can access. THIS FILE IS YOURS TO EDIT. Out of the box, the `body` below makes the OFFLINE fixture work (dgk requirements-pull web:efd). For a LIVE run against your real ALM (dgk requirements-pull web:efd --live): (1) set `url` to a real OSLC resource, e.g. https://alm.serpro/rm/resources/<artifact-id>; (2) fill `attributes.streamURI` with your real config/stream URI (it becomes the OSLC Configuration-Context header — REQUIRED for a config-managed component, or the GET is unscoped); (3) remove or keep `body` (ignored on --live). See README 'Running live'. NOTE: a live pull currently fetches ONE resource URL and parses whatever requirements that RDF holds — it does not yet discover/walk a project.
